cues.text: A glowing blue butterfly flutters in the dark.
The hero stands in a doorway of light, at the end of a field of red flowers.
Aigis's eye, a tear running down.
A dim, green-lit lab. A figure sits in a machine.
Aigis turns and looks back.
Glowing tarot cards drift past her friends.
Yukari, Junpei, Akihiko, Mitsuru, Ken, Koromaru.
Fuuka, as glass shatters around her.
A pale desert of countless doors.
Aigis runs among them.
A red butterfly mask glows.
A key falls through grey sky.
Aigis sinks into red water, eyes closed. Then they open.
The hero drifts upside down through blue water.
The two sink apart, his water blue, hers red.
Her hand reaches for his face.
His face turns white and bursts into spray.
Her hand grasps at nothing.
An Evoker sinks, his face reflected in it.
A phone and earphones drift past, his picture on its screen.
A dark round hall with a sealed golden gate.
Aigis's hands open around a golden key.
A floor of carved faces, flooded with light.
Akihiko and Ken stand ready.
Koromaru, Junpei, Yukari, Mitsuru.
A figure in a red mask drags a long blade.
Aigis's Persona rises behind her.
The blue butterfly by Aigis's face.
The title: Persona 3 Reload. Episode Aigis.
A pink petal settles on white.
